shell_commands: git --no-pager status -sb && git --no-pager branch --show-current && git --no-pager rev-parse HEAD

stat -c '%y %n' ../round-brief.md && git --no-pager log --format="%h %ai %s" -n 6 && node -e "import('ajv/package.json', {with: {type: 'json'}}).then(m => console.log('installed ajv:', m.default.version)).catch(e => console.log('err:', e.message))"

node -e "import('ajv').then(m => { const A = m.default ?? m; const a = new A({allErrors: true}); const v = a.compile({type:'object', properties:{x:{type:'string'}}, required:['x']}); v({x:1}); console.log('errors:', v.errors); })"

node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs => { const pkg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('node_modules/eslint/node_modules/ajv/package.json', 'utf8')); console.log('eslint ajv:', pkg.version, pkg.main, pkg.types || pkg.typings); console.log(fs.readFileSync('node_modules/eslint/node_modules/ajv/' + (pkg.types || pkg.typings), 'utf8').slice(0, 1500)); })"
